title: Dexter Lawrence making instant impact at Bengals camp: 'Honestly, he's been terrorizing practice'

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Dexter Lawrence making instant impact at Bengals camp: 'Honestly, he's been terrorizing practice'
sources.description: A maligned Bengals defense loaded up on offseason upgrades, led by a trade for Dexter Lawrence. Offensive players say the group is more intense and competitive than Cincinnati's defense flashed last training camp.
